about: The secreta of the formulary “Exaltation of the Holy Cross” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We who are about to take as nourishment the Body and Blood of Jesus Christ our Lord, through Whom the Cross became a holy emblem, beseech You, O Lord our God, that, as we have been found worthy to adore it, so we may forever enjoy the saving effect of its glory. Through the same Jesus Christ, our Lord, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: we have been found worthy to venerate it
